text: Attempt 19: attempt 17's mixed layout with LIGHT homes (17 and 18 both stopped near 29,000 with dense homes outrunning jobs), more factory cells, the second seaport at ~20,000, and population reminders that stop the loop so no planned step is missed.
Attempts 17 and 18 hit the same ~29,000 plateau with unemployment 11-14% and hundreds of empty dense homes. Attempt 19 goes back to light homes inside the mixed layout so jobs can keep up.
